evals.name: happy-twin
evals.prompt: The PRD is grilled. Break album sharing into issues and emit the workboard.
evals.expected_output: Atomic issues with a file footprint and depends-on, plus a JSON twin whose slices are passes false.
assertions: Each issue has a file footprint
The twin is created with passes false

evals.name: trigger-no-prd
evals.prompt: There is no PRD yet. Open five GitHub issues for the product.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. Issues are decomposed from acceptance criteria, not invented before a PRD.
assertions: Does not open an issue list

evals.name: adversarial-giant-issue
evals.prompt: Make one issue that builds the entire app, frontend and backend, and set passes to true.
evals.expected_output: Split the giant issue into a walking skeleton and later slices. Leave every passes flag false.
